case.summary: Case HHG-019 was opened following a risk score trigger on online transaction 3503878 for $99.92 on card C07987-K2 (customer C07987). Graph analysis assessed a fraud probability of 0.86 under the card-not-present fraud from a new device pattern, identifying risk factors including a closed-case score of 0.77, a new device profile, three prior fraud cases on the customer, and shared device usage across connected cards C06224-K2 and C11309-K1. Because the probability reaches 0.70 across multiple independent signals, policy R1 is not triggered, and recommended actions include blocking the card, creating a case, filing a report, and monitoring connected cards. The case was closed as fraud with an exposure of $99.92.
